top_choice_rationale: P002 honours the Bistritzer-MacDonald flat-band prediction and the Jarillo-Herrero discovery of correlated insulating and superconducting states, a reproduced many-body platform in which twist angle tunes interaction against bandwidth; the allocation pairs both authors of the prediction with the experimental discoverer, and the citation avoids the open pairing mechanism. The exclusion of Andrei and the field's youth are real costs, so P001 (a clean two-name credit, independently verified accuracy) is a close and fully acceptable second, well ahead of making no award.
